level_one.title: Regeneration Master
level_one.description: Quest: Gathering a Regeneration Globe increases your Health Regeneration by 1 per second, up to 30.  Reward: After gathering 25 Regeneration Globes, you also gain 500 Health.

level_four.title: Underking
level_four.description: Increases Burrow Charge range by 20% and damage by 100%.

level_seven.title: Subterranean Shield
level_seven.description: Burrow Charge also grants a 400 (+4% per level) point Shield for 5 seconds.

level_ten.title: Cocoon
level_ten.description: Wraps target enemy Hero in a cocoon, rendering them unable to act or be targeted for 7 seconds. Allies of the Hero can attack the cocoon to break it and free them early.

level_thirteen.title: Burning Beetles
level_thirteen.description: Deal 21 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. Beetles deal 6 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies.

level_sixteen.title: Epicenter
level_sixteen.description: Increases Burrow Charge impact area by 60% and lowers the cooldown by 1 second for each Hero hit.

level_twenty.title: Rewind
level_twenty.description: Activate to reset the cooldowns of your Basic Abilities.

level_one.title: Moonlit Arrows
level_one.description: Basic Attacks decrease the cooldown of Light of Elune by an additional 0.5 seconds.

level_four.title: Mark of Mending
level_four.description: Tyrande's Basic Attacks against Marked targets heal other allied Heroes near the enemy for 4% of their maximum Health.

level_seven.title: Huntress' Fury
level_seven.description: Tyrande's Basic Attacks against targets with Hunter's Mark bounce to nearby enemy Heroes.  Passive: Increase Hunter's Mark duration by 1 second, and its cast range by 25%.

level_ten.title: Starfall
level_ten.description: Deal 92 (+4% per level) damage per second and Slow enemies by 20% in an area. Lasts 6 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Ranger's Mark
level_thirteen.description: Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Hunter's Mark by 2 second. Basic Attacks against marked targets reduce the cooldown of Lunar Flare by 4 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Celestial Attunement
level_sixteen.description: Light of Elune removes Stuns, Silences, and Slows from its target.

level_twenty.title: Iceblade Arrows
level_twenty.description: Increase Attack Speed by 20%. Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes reduce their damage dealt by 8% for 2 seconds. This effect stacks up to 5 times.

level_one.title: Tissue Regeneration
level_one.description: Regeneration Globes grant 10 Essence.  Repeatable Quest: Every 50 Essence collected permanently increases Health Regeneration by 4, up to 40, and maximum Essence by 1, up to 10.

level_four.title: Hero Stalker
level_four.description: Increases Essence gained from Takedowns by 100%, and gain 1 Essence for each enemy Hero hit by Dark Swarm, up to 3 at once.

level_seven.title: Symbiosis
level_seven.description: Every time Dark Swarm damages an enemy Hero, reduce its cooldown by 0.4 seconds.

level_ten.title: Adaptation
level_ten.description: After 4 seconds, heal for 100% of the damage Dehaka took over this period.

level_thirteen.title: Primal Swarm
level_thirteen.description: Dark Swarm causes enemies hit to lose 10 Armor for 0.75 seconds, causing them to take 10% extra damage.

level_sixteen.title: Tunneling Claws
level_sixteen.description: Increase movement speed while Burrowing to 120%.

level_twenty.title: Apex Predator
level_twenty.description: Reduces Brushstalker's cooldown by 120 seconds and the cast time by 0.5 seconds.

level_one.title: Dash
level_one.description: Increase the range of Run and Gun by 50%. When cast, increase Tychus's Movement Speed by 20% for 2.5 seconds.

level_four.title: In the Rhythm
level_four.description: Quest: While Minigun is active, Basic Attacks against Heroes permanently increase future Minigun durations by 0.03 seconds.

level_seven.title: Combat Tactician
level_seven.description: Reduce the cooldown of Minigun by 4 seconds. Reduce the cooldown of Minigun by an additional 4 seconds after using Run and Gun.

level_ten.title: Commandeer Odin
level_ten.description: Call down an Odin to pilot. The Odin deals increased Damage, has 100% increased Basic Attack range, and uses different Abilities. The Odin has 25 Armor and lasts 23 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: That's the Stuff!
level_thirteen.description: Minigun heals Tychus for 100% of the bonus damage dealt after it expires.

level_sixteen.title: Sizzlin' Attacks
level_sixteen.description: Basic Attacks deal bonus damage to Heroes equal to 1% of their maximum Health. Stacks with Minigun.

level_twenty.title: Bob and Weave
level_twenty.description: Run and Gun and Odin's Thrusters gain 2 additional charges and reduces Run and Gun's Mana cost from 50 to 25. After using Run and Gun, increase Tychus's Basic Attack range by 1.5 for 4 seconds.

level_one.title: Thing of the Deep
level_one.description: Increase the range of Nazeebo's Basic Abilities by 20%.  Reward: After gaining 50 stacks of Voodoo Ritual, gain 5% Spell Power.  Reward: After gaining 100 stacks of Voodoo Ritual, gain an additional 5% Spell Power.

level_four.title: Big Voodoo
level_four.description: Increases the Health and Mana bonuses from Voodoo Ritual by 100%.

level_seven.title: Dead Rush
level_seven.description: Zombie Wall deals 100% more damage. When it expires up to 5 remaining Zombies uproot and attack nearby enemies, losing Health over 3 seconds.

level_ten.title: Ravenous Spirit
level_ten.description: Channel a Ravenous Spirit that deals 230 (+4% per level) damage per second. Cannot move while channeling. Lasts for 8 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Ice Block
level_thirteen.description: Activate to place yourself in Stasis and gain Invulnerability for 3 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Ring of Poison
level_sixteen.description: Zombie Wall lasts 1 second longer, and the center is filled with poison that deals a total of 319 (+4% per level) damage over 4 seconds. This damage starts small and increases over the duration.

level_twenty.title: Vile Infection
level_twenty.description: Quest: Reach 175 stacks of Voodoo Ritual.  Reward: After reaching 175 stacks of Voodoo Ritual, it can also be applied to Heroes and its damage is increased from 66 (+4% per level) to 165 (+4% per level) over 6 seconds.

level_one.title: Power Word: Shield
level_one.description: While Divine Star is traveling out, allies in its path gain a Shield that absorbs 128 (+4% per level) damage for 4 seconds.  If Divine Star hits an enemy Hero, Anduin gains a Shield that absorbs 185 (+4% per level) damage for 4 seconds.

level_four.title: Piercing Light
level_four.description: Chastise pierces to hit an additional Hero.  Quest: Hitting two Heroes with a single Chastise permanently increases Spell Power by 1, to a maximum of 10.

level_seven.title: Desperate Prayer
level_seven.description: Activate to instantly heal an allied Hero for 375 (+4% per level), but kneel for 2 seconds, unable to act.

level_ten.title: Lightbomb
level_ten.description: Imbue an allied Hero with the Light. After 1.5 seconds, it explodes, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage to enemies and Stunning them for 1.25 seconds.  The target gains a Shield that absorbs 165 (+4% per level) damage per enemy Hero hit. Lasts for 5 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Speed of the Pious
level_thirteen.description: While Divine Star is traveling, gain 30% Movement Speed. Each allied Hero healed by Divine Star on its return to Anduin reduces its cooldown by 1 second.

level_sixteen.title: Glyph of Faith
level_sixteen.description: Leap of Faith gains a 2nd charge.

level_twenty.title: Censure
level_twenty.description: Chastise Stuns for 0.75 seconds and its Root duration is increased by 0.5 seconds.

level_one.title: Adrenaline Stimpack
level_one.description: Passive: While over 80% Health, gain 20% bonus Attack Speed and 10% bonus Movement Speed.  Activate to gain 85% Attack Speed and 25% Movement Speed for 5 seconds.

level_four.title: Incinerator Gauntlets
level_four.description: Increase Basic Attack area by 15%, and Basic Attack damage to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters by 40%.

level_seven.title: Nanomachine Coating
level_seven.description: Enemies standing in Oil Spills and Ignited Oil Spills have their Attack Speed reduced by 35% for 4 seconds.

level_ten.title: Bunker Drop
level_ten.description: After 0.5 seconds, deploy and enter a Bunker with 1435 (+4% per level) Health. Blaze and his allies can enter and exit the Bunker at will. While in the Bunker, occupants gain access to Flamethrower, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in a line.  Exiting the Bunker grants 25 Armor for 2 seconds. Bunkers last 10 seconds, or until destroyed.

level_thirteen.title: Collision Course
level_thirteen.description: Jet Propulsion's collision deals 260 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy Hero hit.

level_sixteen.title: Thermal Protection
level_sixteen.description: Each enemy hit by Jet Propulsion grants 10 Armor for 3 seconds and reduces its cooldown by 1.25 seconds.

level_one.title: Echo of the Elements
level_one.description: Quest: Kill Minions or Heroes within 2 seconds of hitting them with Chain Lightning.  Reward: After killing 20 enemies, reduce the Mana cost of Chain Lightning from 40 to 20.  Reward: After killing 50 enemies, Chain Lightning gains an extra charge.  Mythic Reward: After killing 125 enemies, Chain Lightning can now strike the same target multiple times, and also strikes 1 additional target per bounce.

level_four.title: Mana Tide
level_four.description: Frostwolf Resilience restores 15 Mana and reduces Basic Ability cooldowns by 0.5 seconds.

level_seven.title: Rolling Thunder
level_seven.description: Passive: Chain Lightning bounces an additional time.  For 8 seconds after hitting an enemy with Chain Lightning, Thrall's next Basic Attack against them grants a stack of Frostwolf Resilience. If the target is an enemy Hero, then he also deals damage to them equal to 3% of their maximum Health and healing for the same amount.

level_ten.title: Sundering
level_ten.description: After 0.5 seconds, sunder the earth in a long line, dealing 290 (+4% per level) damage and shoving enemies to the side, Stunning them for 1 second.

level_thirteen.title: Frostwolf's Grace
level_thirteen.description: Frostwolf Resilience can be activated to instantly heal. This healing is increased by up to 100% based on Thrall's missing health.

level_sixteen.title: Thunderstorm
level_sixteen.description: Chain Lightning Slows the primary target by 8% for 2 seconds when used on Heroes.  Quest: Targeting a Hero directly with Chain Lightning increases this Slow by 8%, up to an additional 40%.  Reward: While at a 40% bonus, Chain Lightning's damage is increased by 30%.  Bonuses are reset if Chain Lightning is used on the same Hero it was last used on, or if Thrall dies.

level_twenty.title: Worldbreaker
level_twenty.description: Lower the cooldown of Sundering by 40 seconds. After Sundering impacts, it leaves behind an impassable rift, blocking unit movement for 3 seconds.

level_one.title: Extra-Wound Timers
level_one.description: The final grenade launched from Frag Launcher deals 100% bonus damage, and Frag Launcher grenades last an additional 2 seconds before automatically detonating.

level_four.title: Chattering Teeth
level_four.description: Steel Traps will slowly chase nearby enemy Heroes.

level_seven.title: Sticky Wicket
level_seven.description: Enemy Heroes who are hit by Steel Trap are Silenced for 2 seconds.

level_ten.title: RIP-Tire
level_ten.description: Create a motorized bomb with 530 (+4% per level) Health that lasts 15 seconds. While active, Junkrat is immobile but gains control of RIP-Tire's movement.  RIP-Tire can be reactivated to detonate immediately, knocking nearby enemies back and dealing 720 (+4% per level) damage to enemies near the center gradually reduced to 445 (+4% per level) to enemies on the edge.

level_thirteen.title: Gotta Trap 'Em All!
level_thirteen.description: Reduce Steel Trap's cooldown by 5 seconds and increase the maximum number of active traps to 2.

level_sixteen.title: Endless Nades
level_sixteen.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Frag Launcher reduces its cooldown by 1.5 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Cannonball!
level_twenty.description: Increase the radius and explosion radius of grenades from Basic Attacks and Frag Launcher by 50%.

level_one.title: Third Wind
level_one.description: Increases Health Restoration rate to 90 (+4% per level) per second, and raises Health threshold to 60% Health for improved 180 (+4% per level) per second Restoration.

level_four.title: Reverberation
level_four.description: Increases the Attack Speed Slow of Thunder Clap from 30% to 50% and the duration from 2.5 seconds to 3.5 seconds. Each enemy Hero hit reduces your Heroic Ability cooldown by 5%.

level_seven.title: Heavy Impact
level_seven.description: Enemies hit by Dwarf Toss are Slowed by 80% for 1.5 seconds.

level_ten.title: Avatar
level_ten.description: Transform for 20 seconds, gaining 1000 (+4% per level) Health.

level_thirteen.title: Bronzebeard Rage
level_thirteen.description: Deal 15 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies and heal for 75% of the damage dealt. Hitting an enemy Hero with Storm Bolt increase this damage by 200% for 3 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Dwarf Launch
level_sixteen.description: Increase the range of Dwarf Toss by 30%. Hitting an enemy Hero with Dwarf Toss reduces its cooldown by 1 second.

level_twenty.title: Mountain King
level_twenty.description: Thunder Clap and Dwarf Toss each gain a 2nd charge.
